footprint.symmetry: bilaterally symmetrical along the long center axis (front-back symmetry); courtyard creates mirrored left/right wings

repeated_patterns: Lay a stonebrick foundation 1-2 blocks high, add a brick band for the main wall, add a wooden plank trim strip above the brick, then a row of glass panes for windows on each story capped by stone slabs.
raw_elements: continuous horizontal windows on both levels wrapping the facade
entrance walkway projecting into recessed courtyard (center front)
stepped flat slab roof: multiple stacked slabs creating a tiered appearance
stonebrick corner pillars and small tower/stairwell projecting above roof
glowstone or lamp blocks near lower-window corners
raw_hints: Start with a rectangular base with an inward U-shaped cutout to form a recessed central courtyard; two stacked stories of equal footprint on left and right wings.

Lay a stonebrick foundation 1-2 blocks high, add a brick band for the main wall, add a wooden plank trim strip above the brick, then a row of glass panes for windows on each story capped by stone slabs.

Create roof by stacking decreasing-length stone slab layers centered over each wing to produce the stepped flat tiers; include a small stonebrick vertical shaft/tower at one corner extending above the top slab.
Place glowstone or lamps at lower outer corners of the window band for exterior lights and add a small short walkway/porch bridging into the courtyard at the front center.
rebuild_intent.summary: A low, rectangular two-tiered building with a recessed central courtyard and stepped flat slab roof layers. Exterior walls use a brick midband with stonebrick base and slab stone trim; continuous glass windows wrap the upper and lower stories. A small stonebrick tower or stairwell projects from one corner onto the roof.
